Definition: from G4229; to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade:--occupy.
BiblicalUsage: Pragmateuomai means to busy oneself with, to trade, to occupy. In the parable of the pounds the nobleman gives his servants money and says, Occupy till I come.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the time between his going and his coming is working time, and the pounds are his, not mine.
